title: When a Leaderboard Cannot Be Read:\\ Three Rulers for the Noise Floor of\\ LLM-as-Judge Evaluation

priority_factors.observed: At least one bibliography file is present.
At least one PDF is present.
At least one evidence directory is present.
Canonical source changed within the last 30 days.

machine_recommendation.reason: The canonical source has enough structure to repair, but its evidence and package gates remain unverified.

package_blockers: The current source hash differs from the source hash recorded in the native manifest.
The independent review identifies an unresolved producer-baseline/readability conceptual-validity issue.
The source package is compiled but lacks final metadata, license and author confirmation.
arXiv upload requires a separate user authorization and account action.

review_questions: What is the paper's one-sentence bounded claim?
Which claims have evidence fields and reproducible commands?
What independent method/statistics review is still missing?
required_for_arxiv_ready: A canonical source and exact source identity are recorded.
Every material claim is registered with evidence fields and status.
Numerical claims are recomputed from frozen inputs.
Citations are resolved and the bibliography is mechanically valid.
Independent method/statistics review is closed against the current hash.
A clean-room compile and deterministic candidate package exist.
Author, category, abstract, license and upload authorization are user-confirmed.
notes: This packet supports review; it does not assign a final disposition.
Machine priority is not paper quality or acceptance probability.
